messages:
sam: Quick check-in  Need final RN + internal blast for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. We need a pin decision and clear rollback thresholds before lock at 16:00 PT.

jen: Candidate artifacts: `inference-api-v3.0.0-rc2` and `inference-api-v2.9.7`. rc2 passed unit/e2e but flaked on a long-tail latency test in staging.

alex: I'm +1 on v2.9.7 for the initial prod push. Keep rc2 for a staged canary next week after the kernel patch.

sam: Ok pin `inference-api-v2.9.7`. jen please add a "known-canary" note for rc2 in the RN.

prod-marketing: For the staff slam, can we get a one-sentence TL;DR and a bullet list of impact? I'll paste into the org blast.

sam: TL;DR draft:
"Deployment: inference-api v2.9.7 -> production
When: 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC
Why: fixes for tokenization edge cases and throughput improvements
Rollback: automatic rollback if error-rate rises > 3% OR p99 latency increases > 500ms for 15m
Oncall: @sre-oncall
Contacts: jen, alex"

jen: Add deploybot cue: `deploybot promote --env=prod --artifact=inference-api-v2.9.7 --verify=5m`

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled by sam. Promotion queued: staging -> prod at 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z. Verification window: 5m health-check + 10m telemetry hold. Alerts to: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall. :robot_face:

sre-oncall: I'll own the dashboards during rollout. Small ask: include a quick runbook snippet in the RN (copyable commands).

sre-oncall: Runbook snippet:
```
If total errors in 10m > 3% -> run `deploybot rollback --artifact=inference-api-v2.9.7` and ping @sre-oncall
If p99 latency > 500ms sustained for 15m -> rollback
If error increase < 3% but increased client timeouts -> open a P1 and hold for 30m
```

lisa: I'm updating the RN to include the runbook, canary note for rc2, and the perf dashboard links. RN link: https://redwood-internal/docs/rn/inference-api-2026-04-01

sam: Lock RN edits at 16:00 PT. No further copy changes unless critical. If you need to patch, DM me. :lock:

prod-marketing: I'll draft the internal blast and post here by 17:00 PT for sign-off. Will include an "if you see X" section for customer support.

alex: One more operational ask  please pin runtime flag `request-burst-limit=80` in the deploy to avoid sudden autoscale on our shared pool.

jen: Noted; I'll add to the deploy manifest and attach the artifact SHA.

sam: Thanks. Final sign-off checklist: RN locked 16:00 PT, blast draft 17:00 PT, preflight at 07:00 UTC tomorrow for 1h smoke/telemetry. Everyone please ack here if youre good.

jen: ack

alex: ack

sre-oncall: ack. I'll shadow from preflight through +30m post-deploy.

lisa: ack. RN link saved and asset pinned.

prod-marketing: ack. Will drop the internal blast by 17:00 PT.

sam: Perfect  moving to preflight ops channel at 07:00 UTC tomorrow. If anything changes ping me immediately. :white_check_mark:
